name: OrbitCarousel
whenToUse: A showcase on a landing page: case studies, product shots, a few campaign cards.

whenNotToUse.text: Content people browse or compare in the product
More than ~10 cards, or cards with forms and long text

anatomy.description: `shape="drum"`: cards round a cylinder that turns on its vertical axis.
`lean` tips the drum toward the viewer; `center` puts a word or a logo in the middle, and the cards orbit it, passing behind and in front.
`shape="wheel"`: cards on the rim of a large wheel to the start side, rolling past vertically; up to three on each side, fading out.
`shape="wall"`: the viewer stands inside the drum — a curved wall, the edges swinging in (coverflow). Stops at the ends.
`shape="fan"`: cards on an arc, the middle one upright and in focus; a click on a side card brings it to the middle. Deals itself out the first time it scrolls in. Stops at the ends.
Previous / Next; Pause when `autoplay` is set; dots on the wall and the fan.

do.caption: Enough cards to read as a circle; each one makes sense on its own.

dont.caption: Too few to form a circle — use a plain Carousel.

a11y: One tab stop, described by a hint about the arrow keys; ← / → (↑ / ↓ for the wheel) turn it; drag or swipe does the same, the cards following the finger.
Only the front card is in the accessibility tree; the others are aria-hidden and inert. Its position and name are announced (“2 of 8: Research”) — silent while autoplay runs.
autoplay pauses on hover and focus and has a Pause button (WCAG 2.2.2).
prefers-reduced-motion: no turning animation and no autoplay.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Move on its own every `autoplay` ms. Off by default.

props.name: center
props.description: Drum only: something in the middle of the drum — a word, a logo — that the cards orbit.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: The card in front at first (default: the first; fan: the middle one).

props.name: height
props.description: Stage height, any CSS length. Default depends on the shape.

props.name: itemWidth
props.description: Card width in px. Default 240 (fan: 352, never wider than 72vw).

props.name: lean
props.description: Drum and wall: tip toward the viewer, degrees (default 0).

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called with the index of the card that comes to the front.
